name: Xiàng Shí Fù
description: Xiàng Shí Fù ('Watching Ten Sets') is a Chinese solitaire domino game adapted for cards. Uses Chinese dominoes or equivalent card representations. Objective: arrange 32 tiles/cards into 10 valid triplets + 1 valid pair. Also known as Cān Chán ('Zen').

content.text: Xiàng Shí Fù ('Watching Ten Sets') is a Chinese solitaire domino game adapted for cards. Uses Chinese dominoes or equivalent card representations. Objective: arrange 32 tiles/cards into 10 valid triplets + 1 valid pair. Also known as Cān Chán ('Zen').

Xiàng Shí Fù is a traditional Chinese domino solitaire. The name means 'Watching Ten Sets'; it is also known as Cān Chán (參禪), meaning Zen. Play uses a standard 32-tile Chinese domino set; the aim is to rearrange the tiles into 10 valid triplets and one valid pair. English-language rules draw on contributions from Dmytro Polovinkin and Min Fanxin (闵凡信).
32 Chinese domino tiles or card equivalents.
